disclaimer: Indicative level under DBS eligibility guidance (England and Wales). The recruiting organisation decides; laws make checks possible, not mandatory.

roles.label: Teacher in a school
roles.note: Teaching children on more than 3 days in 30 days is regulated activity.

roles.label: Cleaner, receptionist or caretaker in a school
roles.note: Specified establishment: all 4 criteria (frequency, contact, purpose, not temporary).

roles.label: Occasional contractor in a school
roles.note: Temporary or occasional work fails the 4th criterion; see enhanced without barred list.

roles.label: Registered childminder
roles.note: Registering as a childminder or childcare provider.

roles.label: Person aged 16+ living or working where childminding takes place
Foster carer
roles.note: Registering to be a foster carer or private foster carer.

roles.label: Prospective adoptive parent or special guardian
roles.note: Plus adults aged 18+ in the household.

roles.label: Private tutor (self-employed)
roles.note: Applies through an umbrella body; the parent cannot apply for you.

roles.label: Sports coach or youth club leader for children
roles.note: If more than 3 days in 30 days or overnight 2am–6am; otherwise enhanced without barred list.

roles.label: Driver taking children to school
roles.note: Driving a vehicle for children on more than 3 days in 30 days.

roles.label: Moderator of an online service mainly for children
Care worker giving personal care to adults
Care home worker without personal care (kitchen, admin)
roles.note: Check enhanced without adults' barred list guidance.

roles.label: Nurse, doctor or other regulated health professional
roles.note: Add the children's barred list if the role also treats children.

roles.label: Healthcare assistant under a health professional
Hospital porter or patient transport driver
roles.note: Conveying adults who cannot travel alone because of age, illness or disability.

roles.label: Support worker handling an adult's cash, bills or shopping
Taxi or private hire driver (licence)
roles.note: When the licensing authority asks, submitted in the Other workforce.

roles.label: Judge, magistrate, coroner or justice of the peace (appointment)
Solicitor or barrister (on entry to the profession)
roles.note: Only on entry, not when moving between employers.

roles.label: Applying for an SIA licence (door supervisor, security)
FCA, PRA or Bank of England regulated role
Any role in a prison or young offender institution
Court officer, court security, enforcement officer
Delivery driver, retail, office or warehouse job
roles.note: Any employer can ask for a basic check; nothing more unless the role meets a listed criterion.

roles.label: Self-employed tradesperson (plumber, electrician)
roles.note: Standard or enhanced only if a listed activity applies.
